blind_target.evidence_quote: The current study replicates and extends recent work (Bouman et al., 2020; Syropoulos & Markowitz, 2022) which found a meaningful and robust relationship between people's feelings of responsibility to reduce climate change, their worry about climate change, and their belief that climate change is caused by humans.
blind_target.outcome_quote: The current study replicates and extends recent work (Bouman et al., 2020; Syropoulos & Markowitz, 2022) which found a meaningful and robust relationship between people's feelings of responsibility to reduce climate change, their worry about climate change, and their belief that climate change is caused by humans. Importantly, these findings were consistently observed across 31 different European countries, and when controlling for crucial socio-demographic variables.
